verdict.rationale: Apple's first-party docs show a strong official tooling stack for M5. This includes Metal 4 Tensor APIs for programming the Neural Accelerators, Core ML, Metal Performance Shaders and Foundation Models gaining performance automatically, the Metal debugger for optimizing pipelines, PyTorch Metal backends, and MLX targeting Apple Silicon with Neural Accelerator support. A community report of pure C code running fast on M5 hints that the compiler toolchain works, but the evidence centers on GPU and ML frameworks rather than general-purpose development. Missing for 10: any evidence of compiler maturity (Xcode/clang/LLVM support for M5), official CPU/architecture optimization guidance, explicit tier-one OS and toolchain support statements, and independent hands-on corroboration of the developer experience.
